name: Restock Alerts for WooCommerce
author: Store Boost Kit

sections.description:
Even when products run out of stock, Restock Alert for WooCommerce helps you still
make sales. To make sure that you never lose customers to rivals, customers can sign
up to receive an email as soon as a product becomes available again. Our plugin helps
you convert lost opportunities into additional income and provides customers with
an easy way to stay informed. Our Restock Alert plugin easily connects with your
WooCommerce store and is simple to set up and maintain.

Key Benefits Of Restock Alerts For WooCommerce

1. Recover Lost Sales: Instead of losing customers when products go out of stock,
you can bring them back the moment items are available again.
2. Build Customer Loyalty: Shoppers trust your store more when they know they
won’t miss out, and these restock alerts keep them engaged without extra
effort.
3. Better Branding: Improve Store Branding With custom sender names, emails,
and templates this way every notification feels professional and matched with
your brand.
4. Track Customer Demand: Detailed subscriber reports show which products
are most loved by customers, so you can make smarter restock and inventory
decisions.
5. Easy to Use and Manage: Our plugin integrates very easily with
WooCommerce, in fact it is specifically made for woocommerce, it offers
ready-made templates, and gives you clear reports, saving time while boosting
results.

Features Of Restock Alert for WooCommerce

1. Automated Email Alerts With Verification Email Template: Send confirmation
emails when users subscribe to restock alerts. This feature keeps your email list clean
and makes sure that only valid addresses are allowed and stored in your mailing list.

2. Custom Message on Stock Page: Place a custom message over the product page,
where customers can join the waitlist. A good, short line can make a huge impact,
encouraging and informing users to set restock alert emails

3. Follow-Up Campaigns: You can automatically send follow-up emails for those
customers who haven’t purchased after the first alert, instead of relying on one
reminder. Our restock plugin makes sure that the store stays connected with buyers
while giving them a gentle nudge.

4. Discount Incentives: Our Restock plugin for WooCommerce has another great
feature, you can add a discount coupon code directly to your alerts, this way you can
encourage your customers to purchase the product by giving them a special discount.

5. Stock Threshold Control: Set a stock threshold by choosing how many items must
be in stock before you start sending alerts. This feature avoids sending emails when
the inventory is still low, making sure that when you send emails, you are fully
prepared.

6. Detailed Reports Of Subscribers: Get detailed reports of subscribers, informing
you who subscribed and for which products. These types of insights will show which
items your customers are eager to buy again, helping you make better product-related
decisions.

7. Complete Control Over Customization: Add a Custom sender name and email
address in your email to match your store’s identity. This gives your mail a personal
touch so customers can always recognize who the message is from.

8. Detailed Logs Of Email Status: You get a dedicated tab to review the full history of
each email sent through the plugin, which is helpful in letting you know what emails
have gone through and what are left. It also shows the messages that are sent
successfully and those that fail.

9. Back in Stock Email Template: Use a custom template that is included with the
plugin to quickly notify customers when products are back in stock. This template is
also fully customizable to reflect your brand style.

10. Detailed Info of Plugin and Server Status: Always stay informed with the
technical details about the plugin and your server in a single view. A detailed tab is
added to provide this information, which helps you quickly spot issues before they
affect your email service.

11. Logs With Option To Download and Clear: Every action is logged, and you can
download or clear these records whenever you want. This feature keep the system
tidy and transparent.

12. Detailed Overview of Scheduled Actions: See all the scheduled email tasks and
upcoming emails in one place, giving you a clear picture of what’s running behind the
scenes.

13. Send Second and Third Follow-ups: This feature helps you in scheduling up to
three follow-up reminder emails, making sure your customers are constantly
engaged while also not spamming them.

14. Define Duration for Follow-ups: Restock plugin for WooCommerce gives you full
control over the duration of follow-ups. You can define the number of days to wait
before sending the next email.

15. Fixed and Percentage Discounts: You are not limited to one kind of discount; the
restock plugin has the option to choose from a fixed or a percentage discount.

Connect With Support

Perfect For These Store Types

● Food & Beverages Store: Food & Beverages Stores, like a coffee shop or a
bakery, can easily manage perishable goods and seasonal items.
● Health & Beauty: For Health & Beauty cosmetics providers, our plugin provides
a way to keep track of their cosmetics, supplements, and wellness products.
● Pharmaceutical Providers: Using our plugin, pharmaceutical providers can
make sure that all the health equipment and medicine stay up to date, and
customers get an instant alert once these are back in stock
● Event Ticketing: Event ticket providers can utilize this plugin during hectic
times of sales, instantly reminding users that tickets are available and
encouraging them to purchase quickly with a discount
● Seasonal Retailers: Seasonal Retailers can manage holiday items and seasonal
inventory with ease, and they can even remind users multiple times to shop,
giving seasonal store owners an extra edge over traditional stores.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL 5.5.5 or greater, OR MariaDB version 10.1 or greater, is required
  • WordPress 6.7 or greater

Manual installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the WooCommerce plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

This external service usage is solely for displaying informational content and does not affect the core functionality of the plugin. All communications use secure HTTPS connections.
